name: Registry proof producer (lab only)
description: Lab-only: the live half of kilnctl regproof's lab evidence. With <data>/content/registry/proof/request.json it round-trips every mapped live field once through kiln.registry.live (begin/submit/commit/read/revert, the public mapping guard), reads the game's members raw, hashes the entry's resource bytes, and writes registry-roundtrip format 1 (generation live) into content/registry/proof. Without the request file it does nothing.
